discover-repo-map.description: Inventory the repository layout (packages, entrypoints, app vs ai-os boundaries) and emit a discovery-report locating durable paths agents must respect.

discover-domain-map.description: Normalize business domain boundaries from DOMAIN_MAP and product docs into a discovery-report without proposing feature implementations.

discover-contract-inventory.description: Catalog AIOS JSON schemas, contracts, policies, and Zod mirrors; flag reinlined enums and missing $refs without changing product features.

discover-registry-audit.description: Compare registry entries (skills, validators, reviewers, workers, artifact-types) to on-disk packages and report gaps or reserved-only stubs.

discover-runtime-surface.description: Map Core Engine public APIs, orchestration lifecycle states, and runtime mounts so later work targets the control plane correctly.

discover-gap-report.description: Synthesize prior discovery reports into a single gap/risk report for orchestrator planning. Does not implement features.
